pay_detail: 2027 tuition is $8,500 (includes room and board for 5 weeks). Need-based financial aid is available. $60 application fee, which can be waived for families with financial need.
name: National High School Institute (Cherubs): Film and Video Division
what_you_do: Spend 5 weeks on the Northwestern campus making films. Take courses such as acting for the screen, sound and on-set work, and finish with a festival of student films.
who_can_apply: Students in their sophomore or junior year who will be rising juniors or seniors. The page asks for a class rank in or near the top 30 percent, or at least a B average. It also asks for proof of special skill or strong interest in media arts.
deadline_text: 2027 cycle: early deadline January 11, 2027 and regular deadline March 22, 2027. Other materials are due a week after each. The home page says applications open in November.
how_to_apply: Submit the online application with the $60 fee. Then send extra materials. These may include two essays, a resume, a letter of recommendation, test scores and your transcript.
notes: Competitive and costly. Travel is not included. Aid is need-based only. Not a paid program.
